edit.text: Joseph Manfredi is Whitney Frost's mob partner and stands against Peggy Carter through Frost's Zero Matter scheme. His men take Peggy and Jarvis hostage in the desert.
edit.whoA: The SSR agent who fights Frost's scheme, whom his men take hostage.
edit.whoB: Frost's mob partner, whose men take her and Jarvis hostage.

add.title: Agent Carter S2
add.text: Afraid the Zero Matter is destroying Whitney Frost's mind, Manfredi goes to Peggy Carter and Howard Stark for help. He distracts Frost so Peggy and Sousa can photograph her rift plans, and the team pulls the Zero Matter out of her.
add.whoA: The agent he turns to for help saving Frost from the Zero Matter.
add.whoB: Frost's mob partner, who helps her team strip Frost of Zero Matter.

pairs.source: Wikipedia, Agent Carter season 2, ep 8 'The Edge of Mystery': "Jarvis and Carter are taken hostage by Manfredi's men." Ep 10 'Hollywood Ending': "He meets with Stark, an old friend of his, and the others, and agrees to distract Frost while Carter and Sousa photograph the blueprints for Frost's machine." MCU Wiki (Joseph Manfredi) lists Peggy Carter under Allies as 'Former Enemies'. The old stage foreshadowed the team-up, so it moves to its own episode 10 stage.

edit.text: Joy cuts Ward off and secretly teams up with Davos against him and Danny. Once her part in it comes out, Ward begs her to mend things, but she tells him goodbye for good.

add.title: Iron Fist S2
add.text: After Ward carries an injured Joy out of Eden Towers, she tells him in the ambulance that she regrets hurting Danny. Ward apologizes, promises he will always be there for her, and tells her he is going to be a father.
add.whoA: Her brother, who rescues her and promises to always be there.
add.whoB: His sister, who regrets hurting Danny as they start to make peace.

pairs.source: MCU Wiki (Joy Meachum), 'A Possible Future' (ep 6): "Joy said she did not care and told Ward goodbye for good." 'Visited by Walker' (ep 10, ref IF210): "In the ambulance, Joy talked to Ward Meachum and regretted hurting Danny Rand. Ward apologized to her... He told her he would always be there for her." Wikipedia ep 9: "Ward takes her to safety." Removed the stage 1 phrase 'she comes to regret the alliance', which foreshadowed episode 10.

edit.text: Walker admits she compiled a dossier on Ward Meachum for Joy, but Ward later strikes a deal with her: he pays for her redacted military files, and she agrees to go after Davos. The two buy guns from Turk Barrett and storm Eden Towers to rescue Joy.
edit.whoA: Joy's brother, who pays for her files and raids Eden Towers with her.
edit.whoB: Mercenary who spied on him, then helps him rescue Joy from Davos.

pairs.source: Wikipedia, Iron Fist season 2 ep 8: "Walker agrees to help him kill Davos." Ep 9: "Knight, Ward, and Walker find Joy, and Ward takes her to safety." MCU Wiki (Mary Walker), 'Deal with Ward Meachum': "Fulfilling his promise, Ward Meachum found all the files on Walker's history with the United States Army"; "Walker and Ward Meachum found Turk Barrett... Meachum would be covering the cost of all of their purchases." The stage sits at episode 9, where they are partners, so 'enemy' was wrong for its own episode.
